watch.summary: The creator watches in disbelief as a referee issues a yellow card to a humanoid robot during a robot soccer match.

beats.what: Footage shows a referee pulling out a yellow card in front of soccer robots.
The creator remarks on how weird the scene is.
The creator points out that a human ref just gave a yellow card to a robot.
The creator expresses utter confusion at what he is witnessing.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Did I just witness this guy give a yellow card to a freaking robot?
watch.why: The visual absurdity of a referee seriously giving a yellow card to a non-sentient robot creates immediate humor. The creator's genuine disbelief vocalizes exactly what any viewer is thinking.
